text:
One Costco pack of chicken = 8 freezer-ready dinners. 👀

This freezer-friendly chicken shawarma is marinated with Greek yogurt and minimal oil to keep it juicy, flavorful, and macro-friendly.

✅ Prep once
✅ Freeze raw
✅ Cook fresh

🥙 Chicken Shawarma — 367 cal | 55P | 15F | 4C

Ingredients (8 servings)
* 2.1kg boneless skinless chicken thighs
* 200g 0% Greek yogurt
* 2 tbsp olive oil
* 4 garlic cloves
* 1/4 cup lemon juice
* 2 tbsp coriander
* 2 tbsp cumin
* 4 tsp cardamom
* 2 tsp cayenne
* 4 tsp smoked paprika
* 4 tsp salt

❄️ Freezer: Marinate for 3–20 hours before cooking or freezing. Freeze for up to 3–4 months.

🍽️ Serving ideas: Rice or pita, sumac salad, and a Greek yogurt dip.

Your future self will thank you for this one. 🙂‍↕️
